# Nexus Game Launcher v2.7.6 — Overlay Installer Hotfix

This maintenance release fixes **Windows Installer packaging** for the experimental Nexus in-game Modal Overlay and keeps the existing game-library, statistics, customization, and backup features from v2.7.5.

## What changed

- Builds the native D3D11, D3D9 and OpenGL overlay components for Windows x64 and x86 on the Windows 2022 GitHub runner.
- Packages the native injector, graphics libraries, and standalone Python helper outside `app.asar`, rather than relying on development folders or a separately installed Python interpreter.
- Uses the packaged Electron executable for the overlay host.
- Runs CI checks for the staged resources and unpacked application before producing installers.
- Ships downloadable Windows NSIS, Linux AppImage (x64 and arm64), and macOS universal DMG assets.

## Experimental feature warning

> **The in-game Modal Overlay remains experimental and is disabled by default.** It is intended only for supported **offline games without anti-cheat**. Compatibility varies by game and graphics API. D3D12 remains disabled/incomplete under existing safety restrictions; Vulkan is not verified. The Windows ARM64 overlay runtime is not supported. A successful CI build is not a guarantee that the overlay works in every game or system.

The dashboard supports Full / Medium / Minimal layouts, a customizable keyboard shortcut, and time metrics. Pause / Resume Timer changes Nexus playtime accounting only; Resume Game closes the overlay and does not unpause the game itself. FPS remains `N/A` unless verified data is available.

## Updating

Nexus compares the published GitHub Release tag with its installed application version. Version **2.7.6** is newer than **2.7.5**, so an installed v2.7.5 copy can detect it through **Check for Updates**. Use the Windows `.exe` installer for Windows; Linux/macOS assets are provided separately.

This release contains a packaging fix, not a guarantee of native overlay support in published builds across all devices. Please report game-specific issues with the graphics API, Windows architecture, and diagnostics, without including private game data.
